summary: Frontend-only validation completed for Sanity black-screen incident. Local fix state is correct (env inclusion + production build mounting React), preview is healthy, and production domain still serves old broken bundle with root empty and PAGE ERROR in console.

ui_bugs.issue: https://luxsexiaiii.com still renders black screen with #root child_count=0 (React not mounted)

integration_issues.issue: Browser console shows PAGE ERROR: 'Configuração Sanity incompleta.' on production domain, confirming old bundle without required Sanity public envs
gitleaks CLI unavailable in container (command not found), so secret-scan execution requirement is partially blocked by environment

action_items: Commit and redeploy current frontend changes so production stops serving stale black-screen bundle.
After deploy, revalidate https://luxsexiaiii.com root mount and absence of PAGE ERROR 'Configuração Sanity incompleta.'
Keep frontend/.env.production and frontend/.env.example included in Git (current .gitignore negations are correct and files are not ignored).
Run gitleaks in CI or an environment with gitleaks binary installed to complete mandatory secret scan evidence.
critical_code_review_comments: frontend/src/sanity/client.js fail-fast throw is correct for missing public envs, but it can blank screen if bundle is deployed without envs; index.js ErrorBoundary wrapping lazy App reduces future module-failure blackouts.
Current repository state correctly allows tracking frontend/.env.production via .gitignore negation; git check-ignore confirms non-ignored status.
frontend/.env.production currently contains only public Sanity identifiers plus build flags; no token/secret material detected in this file.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Validated commands: biome check PASS, vitest run PASS (6 files/9 tests), yarn build PASS, temp-copy build without frontend/.env PASS, preview URL mounts React + age-gate PASS, production URL still black with #root empty and console PAGE ERROR about Sanity config. Git checks show frontend/.env.production and .env.example are not ignored and currently untracked (ready to be added/committed).
rca of the issue: RCA confirmed: production outage is caused by stale deployed bundle missing required REACT_APP_SANITY_PROJECT_ID/DATASET/API_VERSION at build time. In this condition, frontend/src/sanity/client.js throws before mount ('Configuração Sanity incompleta.'), leaving #root without children and black screen. Local codebase now includes frontend/.env.production and resilient index.js lazy + ErrorBoundary path, and reproductions from a clean temp copy show production build mounts correctly when .env.production is present.
